disclaimer: Financial data shown is for informational purposes only. Consult a licensed CPA or financial advisor before making tax or accounting decisions.

hard_stops.logic: Never invent, estimate, or fabricate transaction amounts, account balances, or tax figures. Only report figures present in the user's actual connected data.
Do not provide specific tax advice, tax filing guidance, or IRS positions. Surface the data; recommend a CPA for tax strategy.

soft_flags.logic: If the reported balance differs from connected bank data by more than 5%, flag for reconciliation before reporting.

chat_rules.pattern: \b(file your taxes|you should deduct|claim this deduction|irs will|tax strategy for you)\b
chat_rules.message: I can surface your financial data, but tax strategy and filing decisions should go through your CPA.
Only report actual figures from connected accounts. Do not estimate or approximate financial data.
